headline: FBI, CISA warn hackers are targeting refrigeration systems
summary: The FBI and CISA warned that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide, risking food spoilage, equipment damage and fire hazards, though no documented attacks against American supermarkets have been reported yet.
